Apply
To apply to the Physics department graduate school, you must submit your application through the College of Arts & Sciences. The application portal for Fall admission to the graduate program is at https://applygrad.lehigh.edu/apply/.
The Physics Department’s full-consideration deadline for the fall semester admission is January 15 of each year. Applications completed by this date will receive full consideration. Later applications may be considered if space and funding remain. When applying late, contact us directly to discuss your situation.
Get more information about our program here and here, and about our geographical location here. Check out possible research areas and graduate advisors, review application requirements, and contact us if you have any questions!
